task.title: Entitlement proven — Part-time employment on an initial or renewal claim

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Employer’s name] — entitlement proven during the labour dispute.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy and Digest 8 — Labour dispute . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy Digest 8 — Labour dispute

step.cmd: Determine if this is a renewal claim:
In FTS, determine if a D5 is imposed on the claim:
In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the labour dispute issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work type: 15 - Manual Action code 11, 12 or 14 .
Remarks line 1: Type “Labour dispute — entitled to benefits.”
Remarks line 2: Type “D5 to be terminated as of [date].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the A-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169) .

step.cmd: In ACS, inform the employer of the decision by sending a Z-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Advising Employer that Claim Approved (2775): Select Approved claim of employee or former employee .

Reason for Claim Approval (2783):
Select the appropriate option.

Messages to Yer - Monies paid to client and Benefit rate for SUB (2788):
Select Warning to ER: To inform us if pays any monies to employee .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a client Note and type “Send the saved ACS letter.”
Determine if there is an outstanding COR Manual Decision WI:
Determine if there is a system-generated ROD with a negative decision:
Create a COR WI as follows:

ul.li: Claim type: Select the appropriate option.
Destination: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Next available user .
Details: Type “A-01-00-01 letter required — labour dispute issue.”
